title: A Primer of the Machete
summary: Teaches an untrained body to grip a machete and make its first draws and drops without qi.

title: The Cane-Cutter's Drill-Book
summary: A drill-book of repeated stalk-cutting strokes that harden the hands and wrists of a beginner.

title: Handbook of the Heavy Brush Blade
summary: Shows how to swing the weight of a broad blade from the shoulder and recover it cleanly.

title: Workbook of Clearing Strokes
summary: A short workbook of the sweeping strokes used to open a path through growth and through guards.

title: The Broad-Blade Footing Primer
summary: Pairs each machete stroke with the stance and step that carry its weight safely through the hips.

title: Treatise on Trail-Cutting Guards
summary: Teaches a circulating student to guard and cut on a narrow trail with a breath of qi in the arm.

title: A Plain Canon of the Bush Blade
summary: A plain canon that adds light qi to the five oldest strokes of the bush blade.
